SAP_ALLOW_WRITES: Create, change, delete and activate objects. When off, ARC-1 only reads.
SAP_ALLOW_TRANSPORT_WRITES: Create / release transport requests. Allow Writes must also be on.
SAP_ALLOWED_TRANSPORTS: Writes only to these requests, comma-separated (e.g. DEVK900123). No limit if empty.
SAP_ALLOW_GIT_WRITES: Push, pull, etc. Allow Writes must also be on.
SAP_ALLOW_DATA_PREVIEW: Read table / CDS data, similar to SE16.
SAP_BLOCKED_DATA_SOURCES: Table / CDS names whose data must not be read, comma-separated (experimental).
SAP_DENY_ACTIONS: Actions to disable individually, comma-separated. E.g. SAPWrite.delete, SAPManage.flp_*
SAP_LINT_BEFORE_WRITE: Run abaplint before source code is written to SAP.
SAP_CHECK_BEFORE_WRITE: Syntax check on the SAP side (warns, does not block).
SAP_ABAPLINT_CONFIG: Full path to a custom abaplint.json.
SAP_INSECURE: Use for systems with self-signed certificates.
SAP_SYSTEM_TYPE: auto: detect · onprem: on-premise · btp: BTP ABAP Environment.
SAP_ABAP_RELEASE: SAP_BASIS release for abaplint (e.g. 758). Normally detected automatically.
SAP_DISABLE_SAML: If basic sign-in gets stuck on a SAML redirect. Do not use on BTP / S/4 Cloud.
SAP_COOKIE_FILE: Path to a Netscape-format cookie file (SSO scenarios).
SAP_COOKIE_STRING: Cookies as k=v; k2=v2 (read only at startup).
SAP_USER_AGENT: Client name sent to SAP. Do not include secrets.
SAP_GZIP_DATAPREVIEW_BODY: Only if a web application firewall (WAF) causes problems.
SAP_BTP_SERVICE_KEY_FILE: Path to the BTP ABAP service key JSON. A browser sign-in opens on first use.
SAP_BTP_SERVICE_KEY: The JSON content itself instead of a file.
ARC1_TOOL_MODE: standard: 12 tools · hyperfocused: a single tool (very few tokens).
ARC1_SERVER_NAME: Name shown in the MCP client. Give each system a different name.
ARC1_SYSTEM_LABEL: One-line description shown to the model (e.g. DEV 100). Max. 160 characters.
ARC1_IDE_LINKS: eclipse: adds Eclipse ADT links to responses (requires System ID).
ARC1_IDE_SYSTEM_ID: The real 3-character SAP SID, uppercase (e.g. DEV).
ARC1_SCHEMA_NULLABLE_OPTIONALS: auto is fine for Claude. on: OpenAI / Azure strict mode.
ARC1_UI: Experimental, read-only view of ARC-1's state in the browser. local: start it on this computer.
ARC1_UI_OPEN: Opens the browser console automatically when ARC-1 starts.
ARC1_UI_ADDR: Address and port of the browser console. Must stay on 127.0.0.1.
ARC1_UI_PORT: Changes only the port of the browser console address.
ARC1_CACHE: auto · memory: in memory · sqlite: file · none: off.
ARC1_CACHE_FILE: File path used in sqlite mode.
ARC1_MAX_CONCURRENT: Maximum number of SAP requests sent at the same time.
ARC1_MAX_DATAPREVIEW_RESPONSE_BYTES: Maximum bytes per data read (default 2 MB).
ARC1_MAX_CONCURRENT_DATA_RESULTS: Maximum number of data results processed at the same time.
ARC1_LOG_FILE: Full path of the file to write logs to.
ARC1_LOG_HTTP_DEBUG: Adds request and response details to the logs. Sensitive headers are hidden. For troubleshooting only.
ARC1_MINIMAL_ERRORS: Hides SAP error details from the model.
SAP_VERBOSE: Logs all HTTP requests (log level becomes debug).
SAP_ALLOW_PLUGIN_EXECUTE: Allow Writes must also be on.
SAP_ALLOW_PLUGIN_RAW_WRITES: Allow Writes must also be on.
